narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly alike, through the layoff in month {layoff_month}. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first of the scores to come apart. The ghost's net worth sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} month only, and it was the last one. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. It could also last a little longer on nothing, its Safety {safety_gap}.
